description: For paper "A Reduced Electrically-Equivalent Model of the IEEE European Low Voltage Test Feeder is a model or code deposit deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Maman Ahmad Khan, Barry Hayes (National University of Ireland, Galway (NUIG), Ireland). This dataset contains the data associated with the electrically equivalent model of the IEEE Low Voltage (LV) test feeder for use of the distribution network studies. This dataset is for the letter entitled:" A Reduced Electrically-Equivalent Model ofthe IEEE European Low Voltage Test Feeder". Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
